description: Signature verification cases for GRUALINK webhooks, shared by every language. Generated by scripts/generate-signature-vectors.mjs in the Node.js repository; do not edit by hand. All secrets and data are fictitious.
algorithm: v1 = lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(key = secret as issued, including its whsec_ prefix; message = "<t>." followed by the raw body bytes)

fields.secret: Signing secret configured in the receiver (a fake test value).
fields.headers: Request headers as received, lowercase names. x-grualink-signature may be absent.
fields.body: Raw body as a string when it is valid UTF-8, otherwise null.
fields.body_base64: Raw body bytes in base64. Authoritative: verify against these bytes.
fields.now: Receiver clock, in seconds since 1970 (UTC). Inject it; do not read the system clock.
fields.expected: valid: whether to accept. reason: why (see reasons).
